thesis: This episode offers a limited view on Amazon, noting a slight decline in its ROIC from 15% to 14.5% while maintaining that 14.5% remains a strong metric. It also touches on Google, observing that the broader value undergrowth of companies has not deteriorated beyond normal levels despite the company's presence.
